title: India and Pakistan Women's Cricket Teams Set for Asia Cup Match
summary: The Indian and Pakistani women's cricket teams are scheduled to compete in the Women's Asia Cup 2026. India has a strong historical advantage, having won 10 of their last 11 encounters against Pakistan. Ahead of the match, Pakistan opener Ayesha Zafar downplayed the significance of the clash, referring to it as 'just another game'. The event is set to take place in Dubai.
summary_points: The Indian and Pakistani women's cricket teams will play in the Women's Asia Cup 2026.
India has won 10 of its last 11 matches against Pakistan.
Pakistan opener Ayesha Zafar described the match as 'just another game'.
The match is scheduled to be held in Dubai.
